title: fix: kindred spirits counts union of follows + followers
body: ## Summary Fixes the Kindred Spirits calculation in the Social tab. Previously it only counted **mutual follows** (players you follow who also follow you back). Now it counts the **union** of: - Players you follow who play the game, **OR** - Players who follow you who play the game A `Set` is used so players who appear in both groups are only counted once. **Before:** If you follow 2 players and 1 player follows you (and that 1 is also someone you follow), the count would be 1 (the only mutual follow). **After:** The count is 2 (the two you follow + the one who follows you, minus the overlap = 2 unique players). ## Review & Testing Checklist for Human - [ ] Log in and open the Social tab — verify the Kindred Spirits number matches the union of your follows + followers who play the game - [ ] Check that a player who both follows you AND you follow them is only counted once (no double-counting) - [ ] Verify totalPlayers count is unchanged ### Notes All pre-existing lint errors (unused variables at lines 120–126, useEffect dependency warnings) are untouched — this PR only changes the kindred spirits logic at lines 281–304. Link to Devin session: https://app.devin.ai/sessions/9b9bec12e3204849a2c4c207961eeb1a Requested by: @noshots00 ---
